create_time.Description: Output only. Time the release was created.

disabled.Description: Disable the release to keep it from being served. The response code of NOT_FOUND will be given for executables generated from this Release.

name.Description: Format: `projects/{project_id}/releases/{release_id}`\Firestore Rules Releases will **always** have the name 'cloud.firestore'

ruleset_name.Description: Name of the `Ruleset` referred to by this `Release`. The `Ruleset` must exist for the `Release` to be created.

update_time.Description: Output only. Time the release was updated.
